component.name: OpenDM
component.summary: High-speed dynamic multipart download manager and media grabber

description.p: OpenDM was created by Nader Mahbub Khan. This is a modified fork ported to GTK3.

OpenDM is a high-speed, native Linux download accelerator engineered with the authentic Internet Download Manager (IDM) segmentation algorithms, native multi-browser integration, and high-definition video extraction.

ul.li: Dynamic file segmentation dividing downloads into up to 32 concurrent parallel parts.
Universal browser integration via native messaging with Chrome, Firefox, Chromium, Brave, and Edge.
Universal Media Hover Panel intercepting media streams directly on streaming websites.
Native YouTube 4K/UHD stream extraction aggregating adaptive video and high-bitrate audio without external scripts.
Automatic media muxing for paired adaptive streams.
Bandwidth limiter, queue scheduling, pause/resume, and credential vault.

developer.name: Nader Mahbub Khan (original author); GTK3 fork maintained by FA Saikat

description.p: Initial release of OpenDM featuring dynamic multipart acceleration, 4K multi-client stream aggregation, and authentic IDM browser extension integration.
